[[Yingko's Claw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Yingko the Skull Claw]], a [[boss]] found in [[Sunqua Vale]].

==Stats==
:[[Dark damage|Dark Dmg]]: 7-11 (Requires 5 [[Curses]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Curses spells (Chance: 15%)
:[[Energy]] +10
:Energy regeneration -1

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as there are no crafter or collector wands that deal 7-11 damage and all collector and crafter wands that require Curses inflict [[cold damage]].

Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], a [[perfect]] technical replica for this item is the [[Wailing Wand]] from crafter [[Honglei Sun]] or collector [[Swift Fiercejustice]].

Except for the visual appearance and damage type, it is possible to create a perfect technical version of this item with:
*One of the following [[Curses]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Seize the Day|Seize the Day]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Curses]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Wailing Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
